records.name: Physical damage reduction application
records.definition: DR is flat subtraction after the raw damage roll and before dodge: damage = rolled_damage - (defender_dr_x10 / 10). Net effect is subtract defender DR once per landed hit. If damage is reduced to <= 0 after a hit, the outcome is glance, not miss or dodge.

evidence.title: Combat Resolution & Defense Order
evidence.sql_port: sql/phase4_combat-BBS.sql calculate_attack(...) suggested by uploaded evidence

records.name: Dodge/evasion placement in combat order
records.definition: Dodge is evaluated after hit chance succeeds and after damage roll plus DR are computed. A successful dodge sets damage to 0 and returns dodged outcome. Dodge is not parallel with AC and does not replace the hit chance gate.

evidence.title: Combat Resolution & Defense Order
evidence.sql_port: sql/phase4_combat-BBS.sql calculate_attack(...) suggested by uploaded evidence

records.name: Special attack/backstab defense order
records.definition: Special attacks use the same two-gate defense order: hit chance first, dodge last. Bash/smash adjust accuracy and damage; backstab uses AV-DV hit chance, ignores AC, and divides dodge chance by 5. No extra special-defense layer is inserted.

evidence.title: Combat Resolution & Defense Order
evidence.sql_port: sql/phase4_combat-BBS.sql calculate_attack(...) suggested by uploaded evidence

records.name: NPC/player physical hit versus armor class
records.definition: Normal hit chance uses attacker AV plus attack accuracy modifier against defender DV + AC. hit_rating = (AV + acc_mod)^2 / 140; hit_chance = 100 - (DV + AC)^2 / hit_rating, clamped 10..99. Roll genrdn(1,100); hit when roll < hit_chance. Backstab uses AV-DV path instead.
